purpose: Teach: 目立た/増額/相応/ホルダー/すじ/ぼっ/婆/爺

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、目立たない服、好きになった。
lines.en: Lately I've started to prefer clothes that don't draw attention.
lines.style: Quiet, observational opening. Pause after the first phrase—he's searching for how to say it. Gentle, unhurried. The tone of someone noticing his own shift.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。年金、増額してほしいわね。
lines.en: Yes. Though I do wish they'd raise the pension a bit.
lines.style: Dry humor underneath. Light, knowing tone—she's not complaining, just stating the obvious with a wry smile. Almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 年齢相応の運動、続けないと。
lines.en: I need to keep up with exercise appropriate for my age.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact. Not urgent, not defeated—just acknowledging a truth he lives by. The tone of someone used to discipline.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: カードのホルダー、お祖父ちゃんが、整理してくれたわ。
lines.en: Grandpa was kind enough to organize my card holder for me.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, slight lift in her voice. Not fussing—genuinely moved by the small care. Tender but unsentimental, the way long marriages speak.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔は、すじが多い肉、よく食べたな。
lines.en: I remember eating a lot of tougher cuts of meat back then.
lines.style: Soft nostalgia without heaviness. Voice trails slightly into the memory. Not wishing to return—just noticing what was. Patient, almost meditative pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫が、家で、ぼっちにしないで、と言ってくれる。
lines.en: Our grandson says to make sure I don't spend too much time alone. He's a good one.
lines.style: Voice softens with genuine affection. Matter-of-fact delivery but with quiet pride underneath. She's reporting kindness like a gift she keeps noticing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 近所の婆さん仲間、増えた。
lines.en: The group of older women in the neighborhood—it's grown.
lines.style: Slight warmth, almost amused. He's noting this small social shift in his quiet way. Understated contentment, no need to embellish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あなたも、爺ちゃんとして頼られる存在ね。
lines.en: You've become the kind of grandfather people depend on, haven't you.
lines.style: Affectionate observation, delivered with quiet pride and certainty. Not a question, but a gentle statement of fact she knows. Voice close and steady.
